meta.analysis: E2 of prereg-v1.2 (brief prompt; detail x arm)
meta.exploratory: thăm dò, thêm sau khi thấy kết quả chính (exploratory, added after the main results were seen); no significance thresholds, read by sign and magnitude

bootstrap.task_set: all tasks of the three tiers together (key suffix .all); per tier under .<tier>

sign.detail_effect: brief minus detailed, within one arm

notes.hidden_pass_rate: not a correctness measure under the brief prompt: hidden tests call names the brief does not give (prereg-v1.2, E2 metric 1)
notes.task_pass: not a correctness measure under the brief prompt (same reason)
notes.score: detailed-prompt cells use only judged detailed units
